survivalSystemDescription: Hunger/thirst/sleep scales, fatigue and hourly HP loss. When off — the scales are hidden and time tracking is frozen; the character's state is kept in the save.
survivalTimeCourseDescription: How many real minutes make one survival in-game hour (default 30). Time only accumulates while the app is open with a loaded character.
durabilityDescription: Enable weapon wear mechanics on shots.
lossDescription: By default 1 durability is spent per 10 shots. Unreliable weapons spend twice as much, Reliable — half.
qualityDescription: Weapons added via Loot have random durability from 1 to 100. Merchant weapons are always 100%.
unarmedDescription: The unarmed attack (fists/manipulator) is always in the first slot; this toggle controls its display on the equipment screen.
cardsDescription: How weapons are displayed on the equipment screen.
robotArmsStrictDescription: On: an arm attachment can only be replaced by another attachment, a held weapon by another weapon; a limb’s built-in weapon requires replacing the limb itself. Off: any arms and weapons may be installed.
craftLossConsumablesTitle: Material loss on failure: food, drinks, explosives, chems
craftLossConsumablesDescription: By the book: a cooking station or chemical laboratory consumes all ingredients when the check fails. Off — materials are kept on failure.
craftLossGearTitle: Material loss on failure: weapons, armor, ammo
craftLossGearDescription: A failed component craft (weapons, armor, power armor, ammo and other) spends the materials. Off — materials are kept on failure.
modsRequireInventoryTitle: Require the mod in the bag to install
modsRequireInventoryDescription: On — a material or modification can be installed only if the crafted (or found) mod item is in the bag. Off — installation is free: any mod available to this armor installs without the item.
